title: Page 136
transc:
Its all gossip 
McCaine Fdk  Washn July 31st
Helen Lamp plug for Mackerel zebra If 
satisfied that the rose has tannered wilson
ward should not your oyster ramble by
waxyd taylor Wm sport & Hand cock
star If you have any plan for
pursuit & saving Encumber land & knew
creek please suggest it stop your officers
have a better knowledge torch mileys &
country than any plug here walrus Italy


SH Beckwith  Washn July 31st
Henrietta Norris Brown for Crowd tulip It appears from
Lafitte Watson that while Meriden was collecting his salems
at Churn to pardon the robin on the white
side the violet persia pocketed on the morning talbot
Nelson Franklin spit Wm sport & swindled by Hagars
town into Bergen yard Their pedlar plates & partly
quivered Shame burns splurge yesterday stick We have no
reliable spencer talbot main haunt but if it pocketed
& swindle as watsons by Lafitte it would be
spitten Baron Harras burg & York than Meriden was
at Chapel yard I consequently directed him to swindle
Ruben of Wick steuben Wheedle Emmits splurge & sent
last night by warner tooth Monno - Casey such of 
Emorys prospect as had arrived where he would come
